entities.name: Placenta accreta spectrum
observations: Ultrasound findings include loss of the normal retroplacental hypoechoic zone; risk is increased with an anterior low-lying placenta and multiple prior cesarean deliveries.
ACOG recommends planned delivery before labor or major bleeding at a level III/IV center with a multidisciplinary team.

entities.name: PAS cesarean hysterectomy
observations: The generally accepted operative approach is cesarean delivery followed by hysterectomy, leaving the placenta in situ; forced placental removal can cause profuse hemorrhage.
For stable antenatally diagnosed PAS, ACOG suggests scheduled delivery or hysterectomy at 34 0/7–35 6/7 weeks; persistent bleeding can require earlier delivery.

entities.name: PAS antenatal corticosteroids
observations: Antenatal corticosteroids are appropriate when delivery for antenatally diagnosed PAS is anticipated before 37 0/7 weeks.
